ModMetaData.name: Custom Base Framework
ModMetaData.author: Evil Eye Guy
ModMetaData.description:
Faction bases are planned fresh on their own map when you first visit them: walls, gates, roads, districts, fields and pens, filled with hand-drawn buildings. No two bases look the same.
Works with RimWorld alone, where outlanders and pirates get modern towns. With Vanilla Factions Expanded - Medieval 2 and Medieval Overhaul, their factions get medieval towns and villages.
Every faction can be switched off in the mod settings. An editor for your own buildings, towns, loot and units is included. Its guide is in the mod folder under Wiki/Open Guide.html.
